2009-06-25: Michael Jackson's bodyguard Alberto Alvarez claims that Dr. Conrad Murray grabbed a handful of vials and told him to put them in a bag after Murray called for help in Jackson's bedroom.
Michael Jackson collapsed and died in Los Angeles at the age of 50.
2009-06-26: Medical experts say they are not treating Michael Jackson's death as suspicious, though determining the exact cause could take several weeks.
2009-07-22: Drug police searched Michael Jackson's doctor Conrad Murray's Houston clinic for evidence of manslaughter, seizing several items, though police say Murray is not a suspect.
2009-07-28: Drug police search the Las Vegas home of Michael Jackson's doctor as part of a manslaughter investigation into the singer's death.
2009-07-30: The release of Michael Jackson's autopsy results has been delayed until next week, according to the Los Angeles County coroner's office.
2009-08-25: Coroner's office documents show Michael Jackson had lethal levels of propofol in his body when he died, and there are unconfirmed reports that the coroner concluded his death was homicide.
2009-08-28: Michael Jackson's death was ruled a homicide by the Los Angeles coroner, primarily caused by acute Propofol intoxication.
2009-09-02: Michael Jackson's death certificate was amended to list his cause of death as homicide, caused by "injection by another."
2010-06-24: Fans gather in Los Angeles to mark the first anniversary of Michael Jackson's death, as Dr Conrad Murray faces an involuntary manslaughter charge.
2010-06-25: Joe Jackson filed a wrongful death lawsuit against Dr Conrad Murray, accusing him of professional negligence in administering a fatal mix of sedatives to Michael Jackson, as fans marked the first anniversary of the singer's death.
Fans around the world mark the first anniversary of Michael Jackson's death with tributes, vigils, and celebrations of his life and music.
2010-09-15: Katherine Jackson filed a civil wrongful death lawsuit in Los Angeles Superior Court against concert promoter AEG and director Kenny Ortega, claiming they failed to provide life-saving equipment and controlled Dr Conrad Murray, who is alleged to have administered a lethal dose of Propofol resulting in Michael Jackson's death on 25 June 2009.
2010-10-08: Jermaine and Randy Jackson criticise a planned Michael Jackson tribute concert in Cardiff as "inappropriate" and "ill-timed" because it clashes with the trial of Conrad Murray.
2010-12-17: The headboard from the bed in which Michael Jackson died was withdrawn from auction at the request of his family, ahead of a scheduled auction of his belongings on 17 December in the US.
2010-12-31: Discovery Networks International postponed indefinitely the broadcast of a medical documentary about Michael Jackson's official autopsy, following a request from the singer's estate and upcoming legal proceedings.
2011-01-11: A judge ordered Michael Jackson's personal doctor, Conrad Murray, to stand trial for involuntary manslaughter in Jackson's death.
2011-01-12: A judge in Los Angeles orders Michael Jackson's personal doctor, Dr Conrad Murray, to face charges of being accidentally involved in his death and not giving the singer proper care; Murray says he is not guilty.
2011-04-21: A judge ruled that autopsy photos of Michael Jackson can be shown to jurors at the trial of Dr Conrad Murray, who has pleaded not guilty to involuntary manslaughter in Jackson's June 2009 death.
2011-06-07: Lloyd's of London sues promoter AEG Live to nullify a $17.5m insurance policy on Michael Jackson's comeback gigs, saying AEG failed to disclose details including apparent prescription drug use and/or addiction.
2011-06-16: Sony Pictures is fighting lawyers for Michael Jackson's doctor over access to raw footage from the posthumous concert film This Is It, as prosecutors plan to use clips to show Jackson was in good health before he died while the defense believes the rehearsal footage will show otherwise.
2011-09-08: The trial of Michael Jackson's doctor, Conrad Murray, was delayed because jury selection took longer than expected.
2011-09-23: A 12-member jury was selected for the involuntary manslaughter trial of Michael Jackson's personal doctor, Dr Conrad Murray, more than two years after the pop star's death.
2011-09-27: The involuntary manslaughter trial of Dr Conrad Murray, Michael Jackson's personal physician, opened in Los Angeles, with Kenny Ortega as the first prosecution witness.
2011-09-29: In the manslaughter trial of Michael Jackson's doctor, a key aide and a security guard testified about events on the day the superstar died, with the aide describing a frantic call from Dr Conrad Murray and the guard saying he saw Dr Murray try to revive Jackson.
2011-10-05: The Black Eyed Peas are no longer playing the Michael Jackson tribute concert in Cardiff due to "unavoidable circumstances."
2011-10-08: Christina Aguilera, Cee Lo Green, and Smokey Robinson are set to perform at the Michael Forever tribute concert in honor of Michael Jackson at Cardiff's Millennium Stadium, though Jackson's brothers Randy and Jermaine have protested the timing because it coincides with the trial of Dr Conrad Murray.
2011-10-25: A nurse practitioner testified at Dr Conrad Murray's involuntary manslaughter trial that she warned Michael Jackson that using propofol to sleep was too dangerous.
2011-11-07: Dr Conrad Murray was convicted of manslaughter in the death of Michael Jackson .
2011-11-08: Conrad Murray was convicted of involuntary manslaughter in the death of Michael Jackson.
2011-11-10: Conrad Murray, convicted of involuntary manslaughter in Michael Jackson's death, defends his actions in a TV interview, admitting it was 'really stupid' and 'careless' not to keep notes but denying the absence of notes caused Jackson's death.
